tex_content.html:
\begin{exercise} \end{exercise} 1. ch6:6.27

Given a connected manifold $M$ and a point $x \in M$, show that a loop based at $x$ represents the trivial free homotopy class if and only if it represents the identity element of $\pi _1(M, x)$. \end{exercise}
